summary: Micware Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting of shareholders conducted by written resolution. Shareholders holding 56,141,914 votes (100% of exercisable votes) unanimously approved the financial statements for the 23rd fiscal year and elected Kazunori Mori as a director. The meeting details were previously disclosed in a May 19, 2026 Form 6-K. The filing is a routine post-meeting report under the Companies Act of Japan, equivalent to an 8-K Item 5.07 disclosure. No special situation is present; the director election is routine and not forced or abrupt.
